title.b: All You Gates Lift Up Your Heads

meta.author:
生命河靈糧堂
詞曲：曾祥非 Philip Tseng

lines.a: 眾城門 你要抬起頭
lines.b: All you gates lift your heads in praise

lines.a: 永久的門戶 你們要被舉起
lines.b: All ancient doors be lifted up in His name

lines.a: 那榮耀君王就是耶和華
lines.b: The King of glory, He is God Almighty
Shout for joy and give Him praise
Lift your hands to the holy place

lines.a: 地和其中所充滿 都屬於祂
lines.b: The world and all that's within shall go to Him

lines.a: 那榮耀君王就是耶和華
lines.b: The King of glory, He is God Almighty
Shout for joy and give Him praise

lines.a: 我們在這裡 歡迎祢降臨
lines.b: Here we stand, oh Lord - Come and fill this temple

lines.a: 萬軍耶和華 配得一切尊榮
lines.b: Glory and honor - All to You, God Almighty

lines.a: 我們在這裡 榮耀君王將要進來
lines.b: Here we stand, oh Lord - Lift You up, the King of glory

lines.a: 主啊 祢百姓真歡迎你
lines.b: Oh Lord, here we stand to welcome You

lines.a: 主啊 祢百姓真歡迎你
lines.b: Oh Lord, here we stand to welcome You
